title: Why is this climate change issue suddenly so urgent? Watch till the e...
description: Why is this climate change issue suddenly so urgent? Watch till the end to know! To know that, let's see this timeline of events: In 1856 - Eunice Newton Foote discovered the phenomenon of global warming in 1856 through ingenious experiments. In 1956, Gilbert Plass proposed the Carbon Dioxide Theory of Climate Change. This theory explains the role of CO2 emissions from fossil fuels in global warming and accurately predicts the rate of warming. In 1957, Revelle and Hans Suess challenged the widely held belief that oceans would readily absorb all excess carbon dioxide from human activities. in their groundbreaking paper "The Effect on the Atmosphere and Ocean of Industrial CO2". In 1988, The IPCC was created in 1988 by the WMO and UNEP to provide scientific information for developing climate policies. The first IPCC Assessment Report (FAR) in 1990 highlighted the importance of climate change as a challenge that requires international cooperation which then led to Formation of UNFCCC in 1992 The most important meeting they organize annually is called the COP (Conference of Parties) In 1995 - The First COP was held in Germany. In 2014 - The IPCC AR5 (Fifth) Synthesis Report findings played a crucial role in forming the Paris Agreement. This report warns that crossing the 1.5°C threshold could result in more frequent and severe droughts, heatwaves, and rainfall, causing more severe climate change impacts. To limit global warming, emissions must peak before 2025 and decline by 43% by 2030. In 2015, The Paris Agreement, an international treaty, was adopted by 196 Parties at the COP21 in Paris, France, on December 12, 2015. In 2023 - Finally, the most important decision was made at COP 28 in UAE to TRANSITION AWAY FROM FOSSIL FUELS To read everything about climate change, you can read my new blog, “Is climate change real? What can we do?" The direct link is in the bio. Go to the Blog section :) Share this video to deliver this message to more people! Or SAVE it for future reference :) 💚 #theecoloop  #climateaction #verifiedchampions  #endfossilfuels #climatehistory  #sustainableliving
